recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a woman with voluminous 80s hair and a leather jacket, featuring a horizontal red graphic bar and a mix of bold condensed serif and fluid script typography across the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome subject against a deep black void background
Vibrant red horizontal bar intersecting the primary display text
Contrast between rigid, vertical serif type and organic, slanted script
Subject's raised arm creating a vertical line that leads to the top-left text block
coreInvariants: Black and white photography for the subject
Solid red as the only non-neutral color
High-key lighting on the face with deep shadows in the hair and clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, framed from the waist up, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes serve as the primary anchor, with the red bar acting as a secondary graphic anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves up the raised arm to the bold text, then follows the red bar across to the script text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of solid black negative space surrounding the subject to emphasize form and texture.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red (horizontal bar and secondary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast in the monochrome image; high saturation in the red accent.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-condensed modern serif and fluid brush script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Extreme vertical elongation, hairline serifs, and high stroke contrast.
Secondary text: Low-slant cursive with connected lowercase letters and sharp terminals.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Q' features a long, straight tail extending downward.
Script letters have a consistent 30-degree rightward lean.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over background and subject's hand

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast juxtaposition of rigid geometry and organic flow.
graphicDevices: Horizontal red bar behind the primary text

preserve: Red color for the script text

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Onyx or Bodoni Extra Bold Condensed
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, vertically stretched serif look.
Captures the casual, slanted 80s script feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a woman with big 80s hair, wearing a shiny black leather jacket, posing with one arm raised against a solid black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a horizontal red bar across the top left. Overlay bold, ultra-condensed white serif text on the left, and red slanted script text on the right.

verificationChecks: Does the red bar intersect the white text?
Is the script text lowercase and red?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the highlights on the leather jacket
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original titles
Any visible brand logos on the jacket

mustAchieve: Deep, true blacks in the background
Clean, crisp edges on the typography

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white text is legible against the red bar.
Check that the subject's arm does not obscure the text too much.
Verify the balance between the two different font styles.
Confirm the red bar is perfectly horizontal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast B&W fashion portrait with a single-color geometric accent and a mix of condensed serif and script fonts for a classic 80s pop aesthetic.
